classificationDefinitions.AMBIGUOUS: The available sealed and source evidence cannot establish one of the other classifications.
classificationDefinitions.REDUNDANT_UPSTREAM: The target function misses, but a separate current blocking invariant catches the defect and distinguishes its paired control.
